label: Possibly, every contingent concrete thing comes to be in a history whose past has a beginning
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred: some history accessible from the selected world contains a contingent concrete individual present at a moment t such that some moment at or before t has no earlier moment, and in that history every contingent concrete individual, whenever present, was absent at some strictly earlier moment. Continuous time with a first moment qualifies. Nothing is said about the selected world itself, about causes, about what is present at the first moment, or about non-contingent individuals.
